text:
maria-marketing: Hey @sam-runtime — can you help with a quick randomized spotcheck for the webinar demo on Tue? We want a small but defensible probe to show variance and quantized deltas in the launch narrative. Minimal artifacts OK.

maria-marketing: TL;DR asks: 10k samples (randomized), 3 seeds, report 50/90/95/99p latencies, token-level cost delta for quantized vs fp16, CSV of raw latencies + heatmap. Need by EOD Mon. Is that possible? :pray: 

sam-runtime: Yep, doable. Quick Qs: what concurrency profile should we use (burst single-user vs steady 50qps)? Also which model + quantization presets?

maria-marketing: Keep it single-user burst (simulate webinar demo flow) — 1–3 parallel streams, sequence length mix: 128 (60%), 512 (30%), 2048 (10%). Use the candidate open model v1.2 and the "q4_0" quantized build we validated yesterday.

sam-runtime: Got it. I can run a lightweight randomized sweep: 10k total across lengths with 3 RNG seeds. I’ll attach run metadata and a minimal runbook. Expecting about ~2 hours on a small dedicated pool.

kevin-eng: @sam-runtime please also log KV cache reuse rate and prefix-warmup counts — marketing will want a note on warmup behavior for the demo. If possible, include a tiny perf.conf snippet we can cite.

sam-runtime: Will do. Perf snippet I’ll include in the artifacts:

```
# perf.conf (trimmed)
batching.enabled=true
batch.max_tokens=8192
warmup.prefix_cache=true
quantize.profile=q4_0
```

lisa-analytics: Add me to the outputs plz — I'll generate the combined latency percentiles and cost chart. Also request that traces include request_id and seed so we can trace anomalies.

maria-marketing: Adding @lisa-analytics — thx. One more ask: can you flag any cases where quantized output differs (top-1 token) vs fp16 for >0.5% of tokens? We'll call that out as a caveat if needed.

sam-runtime: I'll run delta checks for token-level top-1 mismatch and annotate any buckets >0.5%. I’ll surface a summary row in the CSV with mismatch_pct per length bin.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: bench-pool-small on eng-dedicated-2 will start at 1751010900 UTC (owner: sam-runtime).

sam-runtime: Kickoff now (1751010900). I’ll post progress snippets. If it looks longer I'll switch to a smaller sample and re-run later.

maria-marketing: Thanks — if you hit any blocking infra or quota issues ping here immediately. Otherwise please drop artifacts to /shared/marketing/bench-spotchecks/launch-story-1751010101/ by EOD Mon. :rocket:

sam-runtime: Uploading interim CSV and heatmap in ~2h. Final package with runbook + perf.conf + mismatch summary by EOD.

lisa-analytics: Acknowledged — will prepare slide-ready charts once artifacts arrive.

sam-runtime: Interim note: seed=42 run shows a 95p latency at 420ms for 512-length and quantized delta ~+12% token-cost; top-1 mismatch overall 0.18%. Posting full CSV in ~70m.

maria-marketing: Great, thanks. If those numbers hold we'll mention a small cost increase for q4_0 but call out negligible token-level divergence.

sam-runtime: Full artifacts uploaded: /shared/marketing/bench-spotchecks/launch-story-1751010101/artifacts.tar.gz — includes CSV, heatmap.png, perf.conf, runbook.md, mismatch_summary.csv.

lisa-analytics: I pulled the files and generated charts. Quick headline: mean token-cost +9.8% for q4_0, 95p latency within target for demo. I'll drop the PNGs into the same folder.

maria-marketing: Perfect. I'll draft the webinar slide blurb and include the caveat. Thanks everyone :tada:
